title: Kayak Car Rentals Scraper
description: Compare Kayak rental cars with provider, company, vehicle description, quoted price, and booking link. Batch pickup locations and set future collection and return dates.

pickup_locations.title: Pickup locations
pickup_locations.description: Airport or city pickup codes for KAYAK rental-car searches.

pickup.title: Pickup
pickup.description: Airport or city code where the rental car is collected.

pickup_date.title: Pickup Date
pickup_date.description: Rental car pickup date in YYYY-MM-DD format. When omitted, pickup is set to 30 days from today.

dropoff_date.title: Dropoff Date
dropoff_date.description: Rental car drop-off date in YYYY-MM-DD format after pickup. When omitted, drop-off is set to four days after pickup.

pickup_hour.title: Pickup Hour
pickup_hour.description: Local hour when the rental car is collected.

dropoff_hour.title: Dropoff Hour
dropoff_hour.description: Local hour when the rental car is returned.

sort.title: Sort
sort.description: Sort order for returned search results. Accepted values: rank_a, price_a.

price_mode.title: Price Mode
price_mode.description: Whether quoted prices are shown as totals or per-night or per-person values. Accepted values: total, daily.
